moments.title: US Open Tennis Main Draw Begins
moments.blurb: The final tennis Grand Slam of the year, the US Open, officially begins its main draw on Sunday, August 30th, running until September 13th in New York. Today, August 29th, also sees Roger Federer inducted into the International Tennis Hall of Fame.

angles.copy: Game, Set, Match! The US Open main draw kicks off tomorrow, bringing two weeks of Grand Slam action. Who's your pick for the title?

angles.name: Federer Induction
angles.copy: A legend honoured today! Roger Federer is being inducted into the International Tennis Hall of Fame. The perfect curtain-raiser for the US Open starting tomorrow.

angles.name: General Buzz
angles.copy: Flushing Meadows is calling! The US Open main draw gets underway tomorrow. Get ready for some late-night tennis drama!

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Still UK #1
